fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestShipChangeCIFixPrompt asserts the ci-fix prompt carries the reproduce-locally, fix-or-quarantine-with-a-bug and pass-locally-before-push rules and names no Go, make or testscript command; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheckRerunBudget|TestWatchdogCIRerun' shows neither ship check nor the watchdog rerunning a head's failed jobs beyond its rerun budget: one rerun at the default budget of 1, and exactly N at --reruns N / ciReruns N
fields.statement: A head still red once its rerun budget is spent (ship check --reruns and the watchdog's ciReruns, both default 1) is never rerun again: ship-change's ci-fix fixer runs each failing test locally, repeatedly until it reproduces or plainly passes, fixes it or quarantines it with a bug request filed and named at the skip, and commits only once those tests and the packages it touched pass locally
